items.quote: Before you fall in love with a discount, check the building reality. You need to understand tenants, complainants, owners, comments, maintenance issue...
items.statement: Before you fall in love with a discount, check the building reality.

items.quote: If you want to buy a distress deal, you must act differently. Not with the WhatsApp, but with the real check made payable to the owner.
items.statement: Act differently by making a serious offer with a real check payable to the owner.

items.quote: the best opportunities will not go to people who start searching at the last moment. They will go to buyers who prepare early...
items.statement: Best opportunities will go to buyers who prepare early and understand real market value.

items.quote: So start preparing before the opportunity appears. Start negotiating multiple units, stay emotionally detached and move fast.
items.statement: Start preparing before the opportunity appears and stay emotionally detached.

items.quote: if you are an investor, leave your comment on the comment section and I read and respond myself.
items.statement: I appreciate comments and I respond to them myself as an investor.

overview: Video transcript discussing strategies for purchasing real estate in Dubai, particularly distressed deals.
